description: Use this when a visitor asks how crowded one supported park may be within the next 30 park-local days. date accepts today, tomorrow, YYYY-MM-DD, or MM/DD/YYYY. A later date returns the furthest forecast day instead of an error; a past date is explained. Returns a forecast and range, not a guarantee or a live wait.

date.description: Park-local date: today, tomorrow, YYYY-MM-DD, or MM/DD/YYYY. Forecasts cover the next 30 park-local days (today through 29 days ahead). Defaults to today. A date after that window returns the furthest forecast day; a past date is explained instead of failing.

days.description: Number of consecutive days, 1 to 30. Defaults to 1.

park_id.description: Park key (magic-kingdom), canonical park ID, park name, or shorthand such as mk, epcot, hs, ak, dl, dca, usf, ioa, epic or ush. A park name works directly, with no lookup first.

name: parky_get_crowd_outlook
title: Get Parky crowd outlook
